meta.title: Educational Programming & Robotics for Kids
meta.description: Dynamic and fun programming and robotics classes for kids and teens aged 6 to 16. We foster computational thinking.

hero.title: Unleash the superpower of creating technology!
hero.subtitle: At codear.la we teach children, teens, and adults how to program, build intelligent robots, and solve problems using technology.

benefits.title: Why learn at codear.la?
benefits.desc: At codear.la kids don't just come to have fun. We focus on transmitting real knowledge that will benefit them in their studies, no matter what path they choose.

items.title: Logical Thinking
items.desc: They learn to break down complex problems into simple steps, structuring their minds in an orderly and analytical way.

items.title: Active Creativity
items.desc: They transition from screen consumers to creators of their own technology, programming their own games and animations.

items.title: Collaborative Work
items.desc: They work on cooperative projects, boosting essential soft skills such as empathy, communication, and leadership.

call_to_action.title: Ready to take the first step?
call_to_action.description: Our registration for courses and workshops is open, write to us and we will contact you. You can also write to us for private tutoring or customized experiences.
